stages.title: Many small blobs make one cabinet
captions: Blue blobs describe the drawer; gold blobs describe the door.
The picture on the right blends their projected colors.

stages.title: Look closely at one blue blob
captions: It is wide along the drawer front, but thin from front to back.
Its color is strongest at the center and fades toward the edge.

stages.title: Project the cabinet onto a flat image
captions: Follow the colored lines from the cabinet to the image plane.
Many overlapping marks combine into the cabinet picture.

stages.title: Move the camera around the same cabinet
captions: The cabinet and all its blobs stay in the same places.
A new camera position gives a new picture of them.

stages.title: One 3D cabinet, different 2D views
captions: Each picture is rendered from the same set of 3D blobs.
No new cabinet is built when we change the view.

method: Fixed analytic scene; projected covariance and depth-sorted alpha blending; no photo fitting.
guide_outlines: Ellipsoid shape guides; not hard Gaussian boundaries.
camera: Virtual image plane in front of a pinhole camera. Cabinet stays fixed.
source: Original teaching animation, not a trained reconstruction.
